value.rationale: Natural full coefficientwise classification of cliques and inclusion-maximal commuting families of rank-one nonzero partial maps, including exact extremizers and multiplicities for all n. The decomposition into self-domain and external-domain maps exposes a structural obstruction not represented by partial-bijection graphs. The induced stratum is canonical within finite partial-transformation semigroups.
